scope: Selected current Sotto runtime contracts and next parity gaps. A local test is not live provider evidence.

behaviors.claim: An owner direct message is durably admitted once before chat processing; duplicates are inert.

test.name: owner direct-message admission precedes persistence and activation; duplicate is inert

behaviors.claim: A short company blurb does not queue a meeting-prep sweep or focused prep.

test.name: a narrow company blurb does not admit broad or focused meeting prep

behaviors.claim: Explicit meeting prep can select a complete sweep or one meeting without widening a focused request.

test.name: explicit meeting prep remains available for a sweep or one meeting

behaviors.claim: Calendar unknown effects have bounded notices and inspection; a validated late committed or rejected proof produces one distinct final confirmation without rerunning the effect.

test.name: calendar lost committed receipt settles once after an unknown notice

behaviors.claim: Contacts unknown effects have bounded notices and inspection; a validated late committed or rejected proof produces one distinct final confirmation without rerunning the effect.

test.name: contacts lost committed receipt settles once after an unknown notice

behaviors.claim: Gmail unknown effects have bounded notices and inspection; a validated late committed or rejected proof produces one distinct final confirmation without rerunning the effect.

test.name: gmail lost committed receipt settles once after an unknown notice

behaviors.claim: Unknown owner task effects have bounded notices and inspection; an exact late committed receipt or supported task proposal preview produces one distinct confirmation without repeating the effect. Late rejection remains held.

test.name: task unknown notice and late committed proof have distinct sends

behaviors.claim: One explicit owner message can mark several uniquely identified current loops done through one admitted action with separate durable per-item outcomes; an ambiguous target changes none before contact, and the permitted remaining list is read back. This local contract is not a live provider result.

test.name: one explicit three-person closure uses one admitted action and three exact per-item receipts

behaviors.claim: Unknown owner reminder effects have bounded notices and inspection; an exact late committed receipt produces one distinct confirmation without repeating the effect. Late rejection remains held.

test.name: reminder unknown notice and late committed proof have distinct sends

behaviors.claim: Unknown owner preference effects have bounded notices and inspection; an exact late committed receipt produces one distinct confirmation without repeating the effect. Late rejection remains held.

test.name: preference unknown notice and late committed proof have distinct sends

behaviors.claim: The M1.3 bounded notice policy is deferred for literal owner loop, reminder, and quiet commands, plus skill request, routine, web read, requested brief, meeting prep, and offered reply actions; their existing individual recovery rules remain in force.

test.name: prepared unknown-effect notice resumes once after restart without retrying the effect

behaviors.claim: A classified managed-model 502, 503, or 504 gets a fixed failure reply after action-uncertainty checks; an accepted reply prevents activation recovery from repeating the model call.

test.name: managed upstream outage posts one fixed failure reply and activation recovery does not rerun the model

behaviors.claim: A model outage does not turn an unknown owner action into a success or a second provider contact.

test.name: unknown owner action remains held when the model reports managed upstream outage

behaviors.claim: The linked Telegram bot's protected pairing record and loaded Node identity prove one fixed private owner route.

test.name: test_exact_protected_link_and_node_identity_prove_fixed_route

behaviors.claim: The pinned Telegram polling contract commits owner admission or retry state before offset advancement across restart.

test.name: pinned Telegram polling commits admission or retry state before offset advancement and survives restart

behaviors.claim: The private Telegram owner capability mounts routine tools only in attended chat, never unattended execution.

test.name: Telegram bootstrap mounts routines, requested briefs and protected readback while other attended mutations stay gated

behaviors.claim: The model receives in-memory guidance corrected for mounted owner tools and admitted script commands; the rendered startup configuration remains unchanged. This does not grant deferred attended capabilities.

test.name: Telegram bootstrap mounts routines, requested briefs and protected readback while other attended mutations stay gated

behaviors.claim: The fixed Telegram owner route is proved, but its proof is not yet reused for the full attended Photon delivery profile.

test.name: test_exact_protected_link_and_node_identity_prove_fixed_route

behaviors.claim: Attended meeting-prep is currently gated to Photon and is deferred on Telegram.

test.name: Telegram bootstrap mounts routines, requested briefs and protected readback while other attended mutations stay gated

behaviors.claim: Owner skill requests are currently gated to Photon and are deferred on Telegram.

test.name: Telegram bootstrap mounts routines, requested briefs and protected readback while other attended mutations stay gated

behaviors.claim: Explicit Telegram owner morning/evening briefs use scoped admission and the existing durable queue and outbox. Original pairing/runtime/source authority persists through restart, saved result handoff and feedback; unknown delivery never triggers a replacement send.

test.name: test_saved_brief_handoff_unknown_receipt_survives_restart_without_resend

behaviors.claim: Attended offered replies are currently gated to Photon and are deferred on Telegram.

test.name: Telegram bootstrap mounts routines, requested briefs and protected readback while other attended mutations stay gated

behaviors.claim: Telegram mounts protected accepted-brief readback in attended chat only; the receiver requires current source and exact paired runtime route proof.

test.name: Telegram bootstrap mounts routines, requested briefs and protected readback while other attended mutations stay gated

behaviors.claim: Telegram long chat replies split on grapheme boundaries into bounded plain-text posts without parse-mode entities; every accepted chunk has an ordered root receipt and uncertainty stops later chunks.

test.name: Telegram chunks preserve literal formatting and graphemes within the receipt budget

behaviors.claim: Scheduled Telegram long text uses the same bounded plain-text chunking transport. Its complete ordered receipts survive journal reopen without another provider post; partial acceptance remains unknown.

test.name: accepted Telegram chunks recover all receipts after reopen without another provider post

behaviors.claim: Busy, oversized, and generic model failures produce one safe fixed owner reply without a second model attempt when delivery is accepted.

test.name: busy, oversized, and plain model failures send one safe fixed reply without retrying the model

behaviors.claim: A model deadline after an uncertain owner action remains held, and cancellation before a fallback suppresses delivery.

test.name: model deadline after an uncertain action stays held while stopped work sends no fallback

behaviors.claim: A model deadline without an owner action produces one durable fixed reply when delivery is accepted.

test.name: own model deadline without an action gives one durable fixed reply

behaviors.claim: A canonical exact weekday set is shown in the full routine review and uses the existing distinct confirmation, receiver cron, cursor, and receipt path; old scalar schedules retain their hashes.

test.name: test_actual_queue_outbox_successor_restart_and_cancel_fence

behaviors.claim: An exact accepted reply to a personal-routine proposal invokes the existing authoritative confirmation tool without model discretion; an old target cannot repeat its effect.

test.name: exact routine swipe confirms through the mounted tool without asking the model; old and declined targets have no effect

behaviors.claim: An exact /stop cancels earlier work immediately and gives one fixed durable acknowledgement; a prepared acknowledgement resumes once after restart without replaying the cancelled turn.

test.name: prepared stop acknowledgement posts once after restart while the cancelled turn stays cancelled

behaviors.claim: Stopping a hung contacted reply records its attempt as unknown without replay, then allows one control acknowledgement and a later safe chat reply; late provider completion cannot rewrite the unknown record.

test.name: /stop releases a hung contacted reply, acknowledges once, and resumes safe chat without late rewrite

behaviors.claim: An exact /new rotates conversation memory and gives one fixed durable acknowledgement; recovery of its prepared reply does not rotate or send twice.

test.name: prepared new-conversation acknowledgement resumes after restart without rotating or sending twice

behaviors.claim: A failed provider delivery does not become a second model-failure reply.

test.name: provider delivery failure never becomes a second model-failure reply

behaviors.claim: A newly admitted owner skill request has a queued admission receipt; terminal failure or expiry queues one content-free outbox notice while accepted or uncertain original delivery is reconciled without replay. An intentionally quiet completed proactive scan sends no notice. Older jobs without feedback metadata are not backfilled.

test.name: test_research_terminal_work_notifies_once_without_private_failure_or_recontact

behaviors.claim: A future Ask worker failure emits only a fixed unconfirmed research, persistence, or answer stage label when one exact private checkpoint stage is started; this does not identify the cause or change replay holds.

test.name: test_ask_failure_category_uses_only_exact_started_stage

behaviors.claim: All 16 supported owner-action kinds give one honest pending-outcome notice on the original uncertain request without requiring another owner turn. Existing per-kind receipt validation remains authoritative.

test.name: all supported original action kinds send one notice without another owner turn

behaviors.claim: One bounded due-proof wakeup uses the existing thread queue to inspect uncertain actions without another owner input, waits behind safe active chat, and never repeats the effect.

test.name: due-proof wakeup queues behind a fresh active model run and never reexecutes the old action

behaviors.claim: After a settled delayed action, the wakeup retries its final reply only after definite non-delivery, at most the policy attempt bound; an accepted, unknown or dispatching final reply is never resent.

test.name: timer retries only a definitely undelivered late final reply

behaviors.claim: Content-free owner skill notices bind to the admitted current verified route, recheck that route before contact, and preserve accepted-send deduplication across reopen and original-input replay. Legacy owner aliases are not upgraded.

test.name: test_verified_notice_sends_once_after_reopen_and_original_replay

behaviors.claim: The existing memory heartbeat applies the canonical stale-fact archival rule to untouched people weekly, preserving owner corrections, Contacts-card notes and corroborated facts without model work or continuity changes.

test.name: test_weekly_pruning_reaches_untouched_people_without_erasing_owner_words

behaviors.claim: One unreadable person file is skipped and counted; the weekly archival still completes for everyone else and is not rerun inside the week.

test.name: test_weekly_pruning_skips_an_unreadable_person_file_and_completes

behaviors.claim: Birthdays remain visible; only proven VIP or reciprocal contacts admit optional non-urgent greetings, without repeated capture or overwriting real work.

test.name: test_important_birthday_capture_query_pulse_is_optional_and_idempotent

behaviors.claim: An observed greeting after the actual birthday prevents a later automatic optional birthday obligation.

test.name: test_known_greeting_on_birthday_prevents_later_optional_capture

behaviors.claim: An optional birthday greeting expires once the birthday is past the same window that admitted it; owner and ordinary tasks never retire by this rule.

test.name: test_optional_greeting_expires_after_the_capture_window

behaviors.claim: A stored source-backed birthday request without the optional-greeting mode stays an ordinary task in the brief, sotto-loops and the pulse alike.

test.name: test_legacy_source_backed_wish_is_an_ordinary_task_in_every_view

behaviors.claim: The brief and the pulse share one birthday visibility predicate: legacy source-backed rows stay visible and an optional greeting that lost importance hides in both.

test.name: test_brief_and_pulse_share_one_birthday_visibility_rule

behaviors.claim: Duplicate copies of one Contacts card adopt the graph identity instead of being treated as an alias collision.

test.name: test_near_duplicate_cards_of_one_seeded_person_still_adopt_the_graph_cid

behaviors.claim: A missed-call request retains the observed event time so a reviewed specific answer before brief capture can settle it.

test.name: test_callback_capture_uses_missed_call_time_before_brief_and_later_answer

behaviors.claim: A reviewed native outgoing connected phone call can settle only its named callback, with current source authority; the current WhatsApp call schema cannot prove completion. Open risk: CallHistory's answered flag is not known to distinguish a voicemail pickup from the person answering.

test.name: test_rendered_connected_call_review_closes_only_named_callback

behaviors.claim: A short answer is eligible only as the entire observed message and with task-specific review.

test.name: test_short_entire_answer_requires_real_message_and_review

behaviors.claim: An explicitly identified automated-assistant relay cannot mint a new debt; the original observed human request remains eligible.

test.name: test_assistant_source_cannot_mint_debt_but_original_human_email_can

behaviors.claim: Initial history discovery gives the existing composer up to six grounded canonical observations from eligible completed source windows, with one per person before a second, to choose one useful opportunity against current tasks and later replies. Existing importance rules order candidates; incomplete or revoked sources cannot supply observations, and total coverage is disclosed.

test.name: test_discovery_selects_grounded_reciprocal_person_and_holds_incomplete_or_revoked

behaviors.claim: The one-time discovery preserves pending and unknown delivery across restart and never repeats an accepted send.

test.name: test_discovery_restart_pending_unknown_and_accepted_never_repeat

behaviors.claim: Each discovery send claim is recorded permanently at the send seam; an accepted send whose delivery callback failed blocks every later discovery after outbox pruning, and only a definite non-send releases a claim.

test.name: test_accepted_discovery_with_failed_callback_never_repeats_after_outbox_pruning

behaviors.claim: The discovery send honors and spends the shared daily interrupt budget once per run.

test.name: test_discovery_spends_the_shared_daily_interrupt_budget_once_per_run
